Install the Hormozi brain

Pick one. No account, no key.

Works in Claude, Codex, Cursor, ChatGPT, any assistant that can read a link. It installs the right files for where it is running, interviews you, and builds your business agent.

Read https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zqxuii/OpenHormozi/main/SETUP.md and follow it to set up a Hormozi business agent for me.

Claude Code marketplace. Adds the /open-hormozi skill and the hormozi agent.

/plugin marketplace add zqxuii/OpenHormozi
/plugin install open-hormozi --marketplace zqxuii/OpenHormozi

Installs from the terminal. Skill for Claude Code, or the agent for your project (writes .claude/agents or AGENTS.md). Then open your brain board and watch your agent use it live.

npx openhormozi skill
npx openhormozi agent
npx openhormozi live

The board is this brain on your machine. Whenever your agent looks up or uses an idea, that part lights up.

No install. Point any agent at the index. All files are open to other sites (CORS).
